diff --git a/fastapi/routing.py b/fastapi/routing.py
index 9ca2f467..af8f50ac 100644
--- a/fastapi/routing.py
+++ b/fastapi/routing.py
@@ -4506,3 +4506,21 @@ class APIRouter(routing.Router):
             return func
 
         return decorator
+
+    def add_event_handler(
+        self,
+        event_type: str,
+        func: Callable[[], Any],
+    ) -> None:
+        """
+        Register a startup or shutdown handler on this router.
+
+        Implemented in FastAPI so it does not depend on Starlette's router
+        event handler API, which may change in future Starlette versions.
+        """
+        if event_type == "startup":
+            self.on_startup.append(func)
+        elif event_type == "shutdown":
+            self.on_shutdown.append(func)
+        else:  # pragma: no cover
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown event type: {event_type}")
